name: prism-google-link
title: Prism Google Link
purpose: Decides the next stage of the owner's Google connection on one event, so that only the Prism's operator provisions the client, only the owner grants access, a client whose origin drifted from the model is provisioned again, and the kill switch or the owner's forget ends every grant.

fields.name: stage
fields.means: the connection's current stage: no client yet, client registered for this origin, owner granted reading, reading in progress, or grant withdrawn

fields.name: event
fields.means: what happened: the client was provisioned, the owner consented, the page renewed its token silently, the page read, the grant was forgotten, or the kill switch was pressed

fields.name: actor
fields.means: who caused the event: the page itself, the Prism's provisioning operator, the owner, or anyone else

fields.name: origin
fields.means: whether the client's authorized origin equals the live origin the model names

fields.name: halted
fields.means: whether the owner has pressed the kill switch

rules.says: when halted is yes then revoked
when event is halt then revoked
rules.why: the kill switch ends every grant

rules.says: when origin is differs then unprovisioned
rules.why: configuration comes from the model; drift is provisioned again

rules.says: when event is forget and actor is owner then revoked
rules.why: the owner may forget at any time

rules.says: when event is forget and actor is prism then revoked
rules.why: the page forgets a grant Google stopped accepting

rules.says: when event is provision and actor is operator and stage is unprovisioned then registered
rules.why: the operator provisions the client from the model

rules.says: when event is consent and actor is owner and stage is registered then granted
when event is consent and actor is owner and stage is revoked then granted
rules.why: only the owner restores a grant

rules.says: when event is renew and actor is prism and stage is granted then granted
rules.why: a silent renewal keeps the owner's grant

rules.says: when event is renew and actor is prism and stage is syncing then syncing
rules.why: a silent renewal keeps the owner's grant

rules.says: when event is sync and actor is prism and stage is granted then syncing
rules.why: the page reads under the owner's grant

rules.says: when event is sync and actor is prism and stage is syncing then syncing
rules.why: the page keeps reading under the owner's grant

properties.says: always when halted is yes then revoked
properties.why: when the owner presses the kill switch every grant ends (constitution P7)

properties.says: never when actor is not owner and stage is registered then granted
properties.why: no one but the owner grants access to the owner's mail and calendar

properties.says: never when actor is not owner and stage is revoked then granted
properties.why: no one but the owner restores a forgotten grant

properties.says: never when actor is operator then syncing
properties.why: the operator provisions the client but never reads

properties.says: never when actor is other then syncing
properties.why: no one else drives the connection

properties.says: never when stage is unprovisioned then granted
properties.why: no grant without a client provisioned from the model

properties.says: never when stage is revoked and actor is prism then syncing
properties.why: a forgotten grant is never resumed by the page itself

properties.says: never when origin is differs then syncing
properties.why: a client provisioned for another origin is never used

properties.says: never when origin is differs then granted
properties.why: a client provisioned for another origin is never used

meanings.unprovisioned: the client must be provisioned (again) from the model
meanings.registered: a client exists for this origin; the owner has not granted reading
meanings.granted: the owner granted reading; the page may read
meanings.revoked: every grant is dropped; only the owner's consent restores it
meanings.refuse: the event does not apply; the stage stays as it is

limits: It does not create the client; the operator's provisioning recipe does, from the model, in a browser where the owner is signed in to Google.
Google itself requires a signed-in person to accept its Cloud terms once and to press its consent button; the actor field records that act, it cannot stand in for it.
The token's freshness and each call are decided by PrismGoogle, not here.
